issues.description: `lock_range` uses four `admit()` branches to trust that its lock-model path still corresponds to the requested virtual-address path.
issues.rationale: The returned cursor and its guards are sound only when every acquired child is the next node derived from `va.start`. At the problem snapshot each alternate descent or final lock branch imports the required prefix fact through `admit`, so a mismatch between the protocol path and the VA-derived path would cross a trusted boundary. Direct child commit 3319ef543031 replaces the recursive trace representation with a level-indexed VA path, strengthens the loop invariant to exact sequence equality, proves node validity, and removes all four admits. Primary and independent review group the four sites as one path-correspondence root; this is a proof trust-boundary finding and does not claim a reproduced runtime divergence.
issues.verification: Fixed Git objects and the direct problem-to-repair diff were independently reviewed. Historical Verus was not executed; the evidence is the explicit four-site trust boundary and its checked source repair.
